relevant_helpers.role: prove x1 or x2 status checks are allowed by elapsed time before harvesting
validate wait-run framework, source ledger, reflection ledger, and cadence gate alignment
validate phase transitions before advancing version or x-session
launch and gate local app-server lanes through existing callable routes
summarize CLI lane final-message status without publishing raw output
copy completed direct-bridge temp outputs into expected notifier filenames with status-only receipts
verify word count, category depth, and strict sensitive/path markers from temp-only final messages
classify generic marker warnings against strict quality gate results
redact app thread identifiers before publication
scan curated receipts for raw/session/path/screenshot/private exposure before staging

x2_classifier_design: launch_artifacts may publish before completion if exposure-guarded
completion_artifacts may publish only after cadence gate passes
app completion artifacts require app thread redaction before staging
CLI pending artifacts may publish as open-gap receipts if they trigger a bounded retry
retry launch artifacts must create a new no-check boundary
quality and marker-review artifacts require final-message files and must not run against pending lanes
closeout artifacts require all five lanes or a blocker receipt that explicitly prevents advancement
